Population increased in Lewisham

The estimated population of Lewisham in 2024 was 301,255 usual residents, a rise of 0.3% since 2023.

This meant that Lewisham's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Lewisham increased by 0.4%.

Over this slightly longer period, Lewisham was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Lewisham

The average (median) age rose to 35.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Lewisham has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Lewisham is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Lewisham's population of 301,255 usual residents was made up of:

  • 55,268 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.3%)
  • 214,880 people aged 16 to 64 years, (71.3%)
  • 31,107 people aged 65 years and over, (10.3%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Lewisham has a lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (10.3% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Lewisham, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Lewisham
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Lewisham, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 1,984 people (0.7%). In total, there were 3,633 births and 1,649 deaths in Lewisham.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 4,122 (-1.4%). There were 27,977 people entering the area and 32,099 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Lewisham's population of 3,172 (1.1%) as a result of 7,110 people entering the area and 3,938 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Lewisham was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Lewisham in mid-2023 is 300,225.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,183 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 334 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,517 people.
